documents.title: A Site-Aware Representation Learning Framework For Unified Molecular Interaction Modeling and Generative Design.
meta: Luo, Gang; Zhang, Qianqian; Wang, Chenhao; Yi, Zhiheng; Wang, Alex Jinpeng; Tang, Jing; Li, Min
documents.summary: 提出一个统一框架MolDBG，通过结合位点感知表示学习，实现药物-靶标亲和力预测、结合位点识别和条件分子生成，并特别适用于包括无序蛋白在内的结构难解靶标，对无序蛋白介导的PPI机制建模有直接启发。
documents.abstract: Unifying drug-target affinity prediction and targeted molecular design within a single interpretable framework remains challenging. Many sequence-based affinity and design methods rely on global target representations without explicitly modeling binding regions, leading to site-level ambiguity in both screening and design. By contrast, structure-based methods require high-quality structural data and are poorly suited to dynamic targets. In this study, a new model named MolDBG is proposed as a unified site-aware framework that combines affinity prediction, binding-site identification, and affinity-conditioned molecular generation within a single architecture. With binding-site supervision, MolDBG prioritizes interaction-critical residues before learning drug-target representations, reducing false positives from misaligned binding sites and improving interpretability. MolDBG achieves competitive performance across all three tasks while enabling site-specific affinity prediction and interpretable binding-site discovery. The framework generalizes to structurally elusive targets, including cryptic pockets and intrinsically disordered proteins. Overall, these results demonstrate that MolDBG is a promising framework for molecular design and screening. 在单一可解释框架内统一药物-靶点亲和力预测与靶向分子设计仍具挑战。许多基于序列的亲和力与设计方法依赖全局靶点表征，未显式建模结合区域，导致筛选与设计中存在位点层面的模糊性。相比之下，基于结构的方法需要高质量结构数据，且难以适用于动态靶点。本研究提出名为MolDBG的新模型，作为一种统一的位点感知框架，在单一架构中整合了亲和力预测、结合位点识别及亲和力条件分子生成。通过结合位点监督，MolDBG在学习药物-靶点表征前优先关注相互作用关键残基，从而减少因结合位点错位导致的假阳性，并提升可解释性。MolDBG在所有三项任务中均取得具有竞争力的性能，同时实现位点特异性亲和力预测与可解释的结合位点发现。该框架可泛化至结构难以捉摸的靶点，包括隐蔽口袋与固有无序蛋白。总体而言，这些结果表明MolDBG是分子设计与筛选领域一个前景广阔的框架。

documents.title: A Novel SXXLF Motif in the FXR N-Terminal Domain Mediates Coregulator and Interdomain Interactions.
meta: Villalona, Priscilla; Pulahinge, Thilini; Yu, Tracy; Wenning, Jordan; Khan, Sabab Hasan; Frisbie, Crawford Joseph; Magafas, Jill; Barbe, Addison; Okafor, C Denise
Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
documents.summary: 该文研究FXR核受体N端无序结构域(NTD)中的SXXLF基序介导的共调节因子和结构域间互作，结合分子动力学模拟揭示互作机制，对象为IDR且涉及PPI与机制建模，但相分离/凝聚体背景较弱，综合评7分。
documents.abstract: The nuclear receptor (NR) superfamily is comprised of ligand-regulated transcription factors that contain an intrinsically disordered domain at the amino-terminal end, known as the N-terminal domain (NTD). While this poorly conserved domain is known to possess ligand-independent activation function (AF-1), few NTD functions are conserved between NRs. Identified roles in other receptors include androgen receptor (AR), estrogen receptor (ER), and mineralocorticoid receptor (MR). Here, we aim to define the function of the NTD of the farnesoid X receptor (FXR), a crucial regulator of lipid and bile acid metabolism. We show that the NTD engages in interdomain contact with other FXR domains. We also observe that the NTD interacts directly with coregulator proteins. Using mutagenesis, mammalian two-hybrid assays, mammalian one-hybrid assay, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we identify and validate a novel SXXLF motif in the NTD which mediates interactions with both coregulators and the ligand binding domain. Mutation of the motif induces large changes in conformational and allosteric coupling in FXR. Our study identifies a new nuclear receptor-interacting motif that modulates the transcriptional activity of FXR. 核受体（NR）超家族由配体调控的转录因子组成，其氨基末端含有一个内在无序结构域，称为N端结构域（NTD）。尽管已知这一保守性较差的结构域具有不依赖配体的激活功能（AF-1），但很少有NTD功能在核受体之间是保守的。在其他受体中已鉴定的作用包括雄激素受体（AR）、雌激素受体（ER）和盐皮质激素受体（MR）。在此，我们旨在定义法尼醇X受体（FXR）NTD的功能，FXR是脂质和胆汁酸代谢的关键调控因子。我们表明，NTD与其他FXR结构域发生结构域间接触。我们还观察到，NTD直接与辅调节蛋白相互作用。通过诱变、哺乳动物双杂交实验、哺乳动物单杂交实验和分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们鉴定并验证了NTD中一个新的SXXLF基序，该基序介导与辅调节因子和配体结合结构域的相互作用。该基序的突变诱导FXR构象和变构偶联发生显著变化。我们的研究识别出一个新的核受体相互作用基序，该基序调节FXR的转录活性。

documents.title: Discovering host-viral protein interactions in autophagy: A LIR discovery pipeline for identifying LC3-interacting region motifs in highly virulent viruses.
meta: Petraccione, Kaylee D; Wahba, Haytham M; Ali, Mohamed G H; Stocker, Timothy; Akhrymuk, Ivan; Swese, Yossira; Sastre, Danuta; Silberfarb, Andrew; O'Maille, Paul E; Omichinski, James G; Kehn-Hall, Kylene
documents.summary: 该文开发了整合序列模式匹配、无序预测(IUPred3)和AlphaFold3建模的LIR发现流程，用于鉴定高致病病毒蛋白中位于IDR的LIR基序及其与LC3的互作，直接涉及无序蛋白介导的PPI机制建模，方法可迁移至其他IDR介导的互作预测。
documents.abstract: Hemorrhagic fever virus (HFV) infections are highly fatal, posing a significant global pandemic threat as they continue to emerge in new locations. HFVs and other highly virulent viruses (HVVs), such as Nipah virus, exploit host cell pathways, including the conserved host autophagy pathway, to promote viral replication. The Atg8/microtubule-associated protein 1 light chain 3 (LC3) proteins are necessary for autophagosome formation and maturation. Proteins interact with Atg8-family proteins through LC3-interacting region (LIR) motifs, which is a short linear motif (SLiM) found in intrinsically disordered regions of proteins. The presence of these motifs in viral components suggests they play a role in hijacking or evading the host autophagy pathway, yet the identification of functional LIR motifs in viral proteins remains limited. To address this gap, we developed the LIR Discovery Pipeline (LIR-DP) which integrates amino acid sequence pattern matching, with protein disorder prediction using IUPred3, and modeling with AlphaFold3. Using LIR-DP, we identified 43 putative LIR motifs in 166 proteins from 22 HVVs and predicted that 18 of these LIRs would be functional. In vitro and in cellulo laboratory experiments demonstrated that LIRs from the Marburg virus nucleoprotein, the Nipah virus phosphoprotein, the Ebola virus VP35, and the Rift Valley fever virus NSs protein bind to Atg8/LC3 family proteins. The aromatic amino acid in the first position of each LIR motif was found to be critical for these interactions. We provide evidence for the utility of the LIR-DP in identifying functional LIRs within HVV proteins which may provide valuable insight into the mechanism by which HVVs modulate the autophagy pathway during infection. 出血热病毒（hemorrhagic fever virus, HFV）感染具有高致死率，且随着其在新地区持续出现，构成了重大的全球大流行威胁。HFV及其他高毒力病毒（highly virulent virus, HVV），如尼帕病毒（Nipah virus），利用宿主细胞通路（包括保守的宿主自噬通路）来促进病毒复制。Atg8/微管相关蛋白1轻链3（microtubule-associated protein 1 light chain 3, LC3）蛋白是自噬体形成和成熟所必需的。蛋白质通过LC3相互作用区域（LC3-interacting region, LIR）基序与Atg8家族蛋白相互作用，该基序是一种存在于蛋白质内在无序区域中的短线性基序（short linear motif, SLiM）。病毒组分中存在这些基序表明它们在劫持或逃避宿主自噬通路中发挥作用，然而，病毒蛋白中功能性LIR基序的鉴定仍然有限。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了LIR发现流程（LIR Discovery Pipeline, LIR-DP），该流程整合了氨基酸序列模式匹配、使用IUPred3进行的蛋白质无序性预测以及使用AlphaFold3进行的建模。利用LIR-DP，我们在来自22种HVV的166种蛋白中鉴定出43个推定的LIR基序，并预测其中18个LIR具有功能性。体外和细胞内实验室实验表明，来自马尔堡病毒核蛋白、尼帕病毒磷蛋白、埃博拉病毒VP35以及裂谷热病毒NSs蛋白的LIR与Atg8/LC3家族蛋白结合。每个LIR基序第一个位置的芳香族氨基酸被发现对这些相互作用至关重要。我们提供了证据，证明LIR-DP在鉴定HVV蛋白中功能性LIR方面的实用性，这可能为了解HVV在感染过程中调节自噬通路的机制提供宝贵见解。

documents.title: Rheological modulation and microstructural densification of hydrogels induced by Choy sum polysaccharides: Dual applications in dysphagia diets and anthocyanin stabilization.
meta: He, Liming; Li, Junjie; Liu, Enhui; Zhou, Hong; Zhu, Hongfei; Xia, Yanshi; Yong, Yueyuan; Li, Xiaopeng
documents.summary: 研究菜心多糖与明胶水凝胶的流变调控及微观结构致密化，用于吞咽障碍饮食和花青素稳定，对象为食品多糖-蛋白体系，不涉及无序蛋白PPI或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: Texture-modified foods facilitate dysphagia care and nutrient supplementation, yet conventional high-molecular-weight polysaccharide-gelatin hydrogels suffer phase separation, sticky texture and aspiration risks. Herein, cold-set composite hydrogels of gelatin and low-molecular-weight Guangdong Choy sum polysaccharides (GCSP, Mw = 71.49 kDa), were constructed to tune swallowing-friendly rheology and stabilize anthocyanin. DLS and FTIR characterizations corroborated strong hydrogen bonding and electrostatic interactions between GCSP and gelatin, forming micron aggregates. SEM observations validated the microstructural densification. GCSP reduced porosity from 78.5% (neat gelatin) to 36.2%, building a dense, thick-walled interpenetrating network. The compact network slowed anthocyanin photodegradation, retaining over 40% after 10-day UV exposure. Moreover, GCSP lowered hardness (250.3-142.5 g) alongside springiness, while preserving high cohesiveness ( approximately 0.85) and desirable thixotropic recovery, mitigating brittleness and excessive stickiness. Swallowing simulations complied with IDDSI Level 4/5 standards. This work elucidates polysaccharide-regulated protein rearrangement, offering a dual-functional matrix for safe elderly dysphagia food with anthocyanin photoprotection. 质构改良食品有助于吞咽困难护理和营养补充，但传统的高分子量多糖-明胶水凝胶存在相分离 (phase separation)、粘稠质地和误吸风险。本文构建了明胶与低分子量广东菜心多糖（GCSP, Mw = 71.49 kDa）的冷凝固复合水凝胶，以调控适合吞咽的流变学特性并稳定花青素。DLS和FTIR表征证实了GCSP与明胶之间存在强氢键和静电相互作用，形成微米级聚集体。SEM观察验证了微观结构的致密化。GCSP将孔隙率从78.5%（纯明胶）降低至36.2%，构建了致密厚壁的互穿网络。致密的网络减缓了花青素的光降解，在10天紫外线暴露后仍保留超过40%。此外，GCSP降低了硬度（250.3-142.5 g）和弹性，同时保持了高内聚性（约0.85）和理想的触变恢复性，减轻了脆性和过度粘性。吞咽模拟符合IDDSI 4/5级标准。本研究阐明了多糖调控的蛋白质重排，为具有花青素光保护功能的安全老年吞咽困难食品提供了双功能基质。

documents.title: Extended Reality Interventions for Osteoarthritis of the Knee and Recovery After Total Knee Arthroplasty: Systematic Review and Meta-Analyses.
meta: Kalinowski, Caleb; Goldsmith, Elizabeth; Anthony, Maylen; Landsteiner, Adrienne; Ullman, Kristen; Zerzan, Nicholas; Rich, Tonya; Calvert, Collin; Wilt, Timothy J; Duan-Porter, Wei; Ewart, David
documents.summary: 这是一篇关于扩展现实（XR）干预治疗膝骨关节炎和全膝关节置换术后康复的系统综述与荟萃分析，完全不涉及无序蛋白、蛋白互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: BACKGROUND: Nonpharmacologic interventions are important for treating knee pain due to osteoarthritis or after total knee arthroplasty (TKA), and extended reality (XR) technology may enhance treatments for these indications. OBJECTIVE: This systematic review aimed to evaluate XR interventions for pain due to knee osteoarthritis (KOA) or for recovery after TKA. METHODS: Databases were searched through May 2023 and updated in December 2025. Eligible trials evaluated XR interventions to treat KOA pain or after TKA. We classified interventions by depth of immersion and clinical mechanism. We used the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) criteria to determine the certainty of evidence for prioritized outcomes. Meta-analyses were performed when >/=3 studies evaluated similar comparisons, outcomes, and time points. RESULTS: Eligible trials addressed KOA (k=12) or recovery after TKA (k=9). Sample sizes ranged from 36 to 306 participants, and most studies had a follow-up of </=3 months. Nineteen studies assessed pain-related functioning and pain intensity, and 5 assessed adverse events (AEs). For KOA, 10 studies examined interactive digital rehabilitation (IDR), and 2 examined virtual reality (VR)-digitally augmented exercise (DAE). IDR for KOA may result in better pain-related functioning (low certainty of evidence [COE]; pooled standardized mean difference [SMD] -0.59, 95% CI -1.11 to -0.06; prediction interval [PI] -1.72 to 0.55; k=5) and lower pain intensity at 6-8 weeks (low COE; pooled SMD -0.46, 95% CI -0.92 to 0.00; PI -1.39 to 0.47; k=4). VR-DAE for KOA (k=2) produced inconsistent results (very low COE). For post-TKA studies, 5 examined IDR, 2 examined VR-DAE, 1 examined VR-distraction, and 1 examined VR-psychoeducation. Post-TKA IDR may result in better pain-related functioning (low [k=4] and moderate COE [k=1]) but little to no difference in pain intensity (low-moderate COE; pooled SMD at 3-4 months -0.12, 95% CI -0.75 to 0.52; PI -1.63 to 1.27; k=3). VR-psychoeducation probably results in lower pain at 4 weeks (moderate COE; k=1), and VR-distraction may result in 6 months (low COE; k=1), whereas VR-DAE produced mixed findings (k=2; very low COE). IDR was not associated with AEs, and VR may not be associated with AEs for KOA (high and low COE), though AE reporting was uncommon (k=5) and evidence was very uncertain for post-TKA. CONCLUSIONS: IDR may augment treatment for KOA and post-TKA recovery, and VR may benefit post-TKA rehabilitation. This review is the first to stratify by level of immersion, clinical mechanism, and follow-up duration and to systematically evaluate AEs. IDR may be ready for integration into KOA care, while use after TKA needs more evidence. Randomized controlled trials with implementation outcomes could determine how XR interventions can be used for KOA, whereas trials evaluating efficacy and AEs are needed before their use for post-TKA. 背景：非药物干预对于治疗膝骨关节炎或全膝关节置换术（TKA）后的膝关节疼痛至关重要，而扩展现实（XR）技术可能增强针对这些适应症的治疗效果。目的：本系统评价旨在评估XR干预对膝骨关节炎（KOA）疼痛或TKA术后恢复的效果。方法：数据库检索截至2023年5月，并于2025年12月更新。符合条件的试验评估了XR干预用于治疗KOA疼痛或TKA术后恢复。我们根据沉浸深度和临床机制对干预措施进行分类。我们使用推荐分级评估、制定与评价（GRADE）标准来确定优先结局的证据确定性。当≥3项研究评估了相似的比较、结局和时间点时，进行荟萃分析。结果：符合条件的试验涉及KOA（k=12）或TKA术后恢复（k=9）。样本量范围为36至306名参与者，大多数研究的随访时间≤3个月。19项研究评估了疼痛相关功能及疼痛强度，5项评估了不良事件（AEs）。对于KOA，10项研究考察了交互式数字康复（IDR），2项考察了虚拟现实（VR）-数字增强运动（DAE）。IDR用于KOA可能在疼痛相关功能方面产生更好效果（低证据确定性[COE]；合并标准化均数差[SMD] -0.59，95% CI -1.11至-0.06；预测区间[PI] -1.72至0.55；k=5），并在6-8周时降低疼痛强度（低COE；合并SMD -0.46，95% CI -0.92至0.00；PI -1.39至0.47；k=4）。VR-DAE用于KOA（k=2）产生不一致的结果（极低COE）。对于TKA术后研究，5项考察了IDR，2项考察了VR-DAE，1项考察了VR-分散注意力，1项考察了VR-心理教育。TKA术后IDR可能在疼痛相关功能方面产生更好效果（低[k=4]和中度COE [k=1]），但在疼痛强度方面几乎没有差异（低-中度COE；3-4个月时合并SMD -0.12，95% CI -0.75至0.52；PI -1.63至1.27；k=3）。VR-心理教育可能在4周时降低疼痛（中度COE；k=1），VR-分散注意力可能在6个月时降低疼痛（低COE；k=1），而VR-DAE产生混合结果（k=2；极低COE）。IDR与AEs无关，VR可能对KOA不产生AEs（高和低COE），尽管AE报告不常见（k=5），且TKA术后证据非常不确定。结论：IDR可能增强KOA和TKA术后恢复的治疗效果，VR可能有益于TKA术后康复。本综述首次按沉浸水平、临床机制和随访持续时间进行分层，并系统评估AEs。IDR可能已准备好整合到KOA护理中，而TKA术后使用需要更多证据。具有实施结局的随机对照试验可以确定XR干预如何用于KOA，而在TKA术后使用前，需要评估疗效和AEs的试验。

documents.title: Membrane Phase, Charge, and Curvature Regulate alpha-Synuclein Binding Dynamics.
meta: Kou, Orianna H; Sakurai, Cailyn M; Ramirez, Stephanie Y; Kim, Brian H; Johnson, David H; Zhang, Zixin; Lee, Christopher T; Zeno, Wade F
Langmuir : the ACS journal of surfaces and colloids
documents.summary: 该文通过实验与粗粒化分子动力学模拟，系统研究了膜相、电荷和曲率如何协同调控α-突触核蛋白（一种无序蛋白）与膜的结合动力学与曲率敏感性，揭示了无序蛋白-膜互作的热力学与动力学机制，对理解IDP介导的界面互作建模具有直接启发。
documents.abstract: alpha-Synuclein (alphaSyn) is an intrinsically disordered protein whose interactions with lipid membranes are central to both its physiological function and its role in synucleopathies. While membrane charge, phase, and curvature are each known to influence alphaSyn binding, these properties are typically examined independently, leaving their combined effects on both equilibrium and dynamic membrane association unresolved. Here, we systematically investigate how membrane phase and charge jointly regulate alphaSyn binding, curvature sensitivity, and exchange dynamics using fluorescence microscopy, circular dichroism spectroscopy, and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching (FRAP), complemented by coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations. Under zwitterionic conditions, alphaSyn preferentially binds highly curved gel-phase membranes, driven by curvature-dependent enrichment of packing defects arising from faceted vesicle morphologies. Incorporation of anionic lipids selectively enhances binding in liquid-phase membranes while attenuating curvature-dependent partitioning in gel-phase membranes. Dynamic measurements reveal that membrane phase and charge also govern the stability of membrane-associated alphaSyn, with gel-phase membranes and anionic lipids promoting kinetically stabilized states. Simulations show that curvature-induced defect formation is strongly amplified in gel-phase membranes but largely insensitive to charge. These findings establish that alphaSyn-membrane interactions are governed by a cooperative interplay between membrane phase, curvature, and charge and highlight the importance of resolving both thermodynamic and kinetic contributions to protein-membrane binding. α-突触核蛋白（alphaSyn）是一种本质无序蛋白，其与脂质膜的相互作用对其生理功能和突触核蛋白病中的作用均至关重要。尽管已知膜电荷、相态和曲率各自影响alphaSyn的结合，但这些特性通常被独立研究，导致它们对平衡态和动态膜关联的综合效应尚未明确。本文中，我们利用荧光显微镜、圆二色光谱和光漂白后荧光恢复（FRAP）技术，并结合粗粒化分子动力学模拟，系统研究了膜相态和电荷如何共同调控alphaSyn的结合、曲率敏感性和交换动力学。在双离子条件下，alphaSyn优先结合高曲率的凝胶相膜，这是由多面体囊泡形态产生的堆积缺陷的曲率依赖性富集所驱动的。阴离子脂质的掺入选择性地增强了液相膜中的结合，同时减弱了凝胶相膜中曲率依赖性的分配。动态测量表明，膜相态和电荷也调控膜结合alphaSyn的稳定性，其中凝胶相膜和阴离子脂质促进了动力学稳定状态。模拟显示，曲率诱导的缺陷形成在凝胶相膜中显著增强，但对电荷基本不敏感。这些发现确立了alphaSyn-膜相互作用受膜相态、曲率和电荷之间的协同调控，并强调了解析蛋白质-膜结合的热力学和动力学贡献的重要性。

documents.title: Biomolecular Condensates Dictate the Folding Landscape of Protein Alpha-Helices.
meta: Journal of the American Chemical Society
documents.summary: 该文通过原子模拟和贝叶斯优化建模，揭示了生物分子凝聚体如何通过多价相互作用与拥挤效应的平衡重塑蛋白α-螺旋的折叠景观，并耦合凝聚体蛋白接触重排导致动力学受阻，直接关联无序蛋白/IDR介导的相分离中PPI机制建模。
documents.abstract: Protein structure is exquisitely sensitive to the surrounding chemical environment, and many proteins encounter complex environments within cells. Importantly, numerous proteins organize into biomolecular condensates horizontal line dense macromolecular assemblies with distinct physicochemical properties. This raises a fundamental question: how do condensates reshape protein structure and dynamics? Here, we investigate how protein folding landscapes are altered inside condensates, using the protein alpha-helix as a model folded domain. Atomistic simulations suggest the helix-coil transition within condensates differs markedly from its behavior in dilute solution or in the presence of inert crowders. We then use Bayesian optimization to develop a chemically specific, residue-resolution model for quantification of alpha-helical folding and apply it to characterize diverse helices, including alpha-helical domains from the disease-associated proteins TDP-43, Annexin A11, and Androgen Receptor, within condensates of varying physicochemical properties. Our results support a framework in which multivalent interactions drive unfolding while crowding promotes folding, and alpha-helix conformational ensembles inside condensates emerge from this balance. Additionally, we show that helix folding transitions are kinetically frustrated inside condensates because they are coupled to the time scale of contact rearrangement with co-condensate proteins. As such, alpha-helix folding landscapes within condensates are dually sequence-dependent, informed by both the sequence of the alpha-helical domain and co-condensate proteins. Together, our work has implications for understanding condensate-mediated proteinopathies, targeting aberrant condensates, and designing condensates to program protein function across scales. 蛋白质结构对周围化学环境极为敏感，许多蛋白质在细胞内会遭遇复杂环境。重要的是，大量蛋白质会组织成生物分子凝聚体 (biomolecular condensates)——即具有独特物理化学性质的致密大分子组装体。这引出一个基本问题：凝聚体如何重塑蛋白质的结构与动力学？在此，我们以蛋白质α-螺旋 (alpha-helix) 作为折叠结构域模型，研究凝聚体内部蛋白质折叠景观如何改变。原子模拟 (atomistic simulations) 表明，凝聚体中的螺旋-卷曲转变 (helix-coil transition) 与稀溶液或惰性拥挤剂存在时的行为显著不同。随后，我们利用贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian optimization) 开发了一种化学特异性、残基分辨率的模型，用于定量α-螺旋折叠，并将其应用于表征不同物理化学性质凝聚体中的多种螺旋，包括来自疾病相关蛋白TDP-43、Annexin A11和雄激素受体 (Androgen Receptor) 的α-螺旋结构域。我们的结果支持一个框架：多价相互作用 (multivalent interactions) 驱动去折叠，而拥挤效应促进折叠，凝聚体内部的α-螺旋构象系综 (conformational ensembles) 由此平衡产生。此外，我们表明，凝聚体内部的螺旋折叠转变在动力学上受到阻碍，因为它们与共凝聚体蛋白 (co-condensate proteins) 的接触重排时间尺度相耦合。因此，凝聚体内部的α-螺旋折叠景观具有双重序列依赖性，既受α-螺旋结构域序列的影响，也受共凝聚体蛋白序列的影响。总体而言，我们的工作对理解凝聚体介导的蛋白质病 (condensate-mediated proteinopathies)、靶向异常凝聚体以及设计凝聚体以跨尺度编程蛋白质功能具有重要意义。

documents.title: Reconstitution of multistep recruitment of ULK1 to membranes in autophagy.
meta: Duan, Yongjia; Lu, Ye; Paul, Sanjoy; Betz, Johannes; Wilhelm, Lea P; Cook, Annan S I; Ren, Xuefeng; Adriaenssens, Elias; Martens, Sascha; Ganley, Ian G; Hummer, Gerhard; Hurley, James H
documents.summary: 该文通过生化重建和分子动力学模拟，揭示了ULK1无序区域中的PVP基序与ATG13:ATG101 HORMA二聚体结合，协同WIPI蛋白将ULK1激酶结构域招募至自噬体膜的多步骤机制，直接涉及IDR介导的PPI及膜结合机制建模。
documents.abstract: The human Unc51-like kinase 1 (ULK1) autophagy-initiating complex consists of ULK1, FIP200, and the Hop/Rev7/Mad2 (HORMA) domain heterodimer ATG13:ATG101. Phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) is essential to recruit ULK1 complex (ULK1C) to membranes for ULK1, but ULK1C subunits do not contain PI3P-binding domains. Here, we show that the ATG13:ATG101 dimer forms a complex with the PI3P-binding protein WD40 interacting with phosphoinositide protein 3 (WIPI3), as well as WIPI2. Bound to WIPI2 and WIPI3, ATG13:ATG101 inserts its Trp-Phe (WF) finger into the membrane. Molecular dynamics simulations show that WIPIs and the WF finger cooperatively stabilize the complex on membranes. Biochemical reconstitution and cell-based assays show that WIPI3:ATG13 engagement promotes ATG16L1 phosphorylation, autophagy, and mitophagy. A kinase domain (KD)-proximal Pro-Val-Pro (PVP) motif in the ULK1 intrinsically disordered region docks onto the ATG13:ATG101 HORMA dimer brings the ULK1 KD close to the membrane. The PVP motif is essential for in vitro ULK1 phosphorylation of ATG16L1 and important for autophagy and mitophagy. These data establish a stepwise pathway for recruitment of the ULK1 KD to the vicinity of the membrane surface. 人类Unc51样激酶1（ULK1）自噬起始复合物由ULK1、FIP200以及Hop/Rev7/Mad2（HORMA）结构域异二聚体ATG13:ATG101组成。磷脂酰肌醇3-磷酸（PI3P）对于将ULK1复合物（ULK1C）招募至膜上以启动ULK1功能至关重要，但ULK1C亚基并不包含PI3P结合结构域。在此，我们证明ATG13:ATG101二聚体与PI3P结合蛋白WD40相互作用蛋白3（WIPI3）以及WIPI2形成复合物。与WIPI2和WIPI3结合后，ATG13:ATG101将其Trp-Phe（WF）指状结构插入膜中。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟显示，WIPIs与WF指状结构协同稳定膜上的复合物。生化重建实验和基于细胞的实验表明，WIPI3:ATG13的结合促进ATG16L1磷酸化、自噬及线粒体自噬。ULK1内在无序区中的一个激酶结构域（KD）近端Pro-Val-Pro（PVP）基序对接至ATG13:ATG101 HORMA二聚体上，将ULK1 KD拉近至膜附近。PVP基序对于体外ULK1磷酸化ATG16L1至关重要，并对自噬和线粒体自噬具有重要作用。这些数据确立了将ULK1 KD招募至膜表面附近的逐步通路。

documents.title: Retrieval of binding sites across the AlphaFold human proteome using protein language model representations
documents.summary: 该文用蛋白质语言模型ESM-2检索AlphaFold人类蛋白质组中的结合位点，虽涉及PPI界面预测，但对象非无序蛋白/IDR，且方法侧重检索而非互作机制建模，对本课题的启发有限。
documents.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) provide powerful representations of protein sequence, but their utility for proteome-scale binding-site retrieval remains unclear. Here, we present PocketScope, a training-free framework that represents cavity-lining residues using frozen ESM-C 600M embeddings and retrieves related binding sites through exhaustive lateinteraction MaxSim, without pooling or approximate nearest-neighbor search. PocketScope identified 153,805 cavities across 37,682 proteins in the AlphaFold human proteome and recovered documented drug off-targets across a curated set of pharmacological pairs. On the ProSPECCTs benchmark, PocketScope ranks 1st of 23 methods by mean rank across the ten collections. PocketScope provides a practical framework for proteome-scale off-target prediction. PocketScope is open source and also freely available as a web server at https://www.bhargavaresearch.org/pocketscope . 蛋白质语言模型（Protein language models, PLMs）为蛋白质序列提供了强大的表征，但其在蛋白质组规模结合位点检索中的实用性仍不明确。在此，我们提出PocketScope，一种无需训练的框架，该框架使用冻结的ESM-C 600M嵌入表示空腔衬里残基，并通过穷举式后期交互MaxSim（无需池化或近似最近邻搜索）检索相关结合位点。PocketScope在AlphaFold人类蛋白质组中识别出37,682个蛋白质上的153,805个空腔，并在一个精选的药理学配对集合中恢复了已记录的药物脱靶效应。在ProSPECCTs基准测试中，PocketScope在十个集合的平均排名中位列23种方法中的第1名。PocketScope为蛋白质组规模的脱靶预测提供了一个实用框架。PocketScope是开源的，也可通过网站https://www.bhargavaresearch.org/pocketscope 免费获取。

documents.title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Protein Language Model Embeddings for Drug–Target Affinity Prediction
documents.summary: 该文评估蛋白质语言模型嵌入对药物-靶标亲和力预测的影响，但对象为折叠蛋白与小分子药物，不涉及无序蛋白/IDR/相分离，且仅关注亲和力预测而非互作机制建模，与本课题关联度低。
documents.abstract: Accurate identification of drug–target interactions is consequential for novel drug discovery and development. Deep learning methods for drug–target affinity (DTA) prediction have shown great promise in accelerating drug discovery and reducing development costs. Although graph neural networks have improved drug representation learning for DTA prediction tasks, many models still struggle to effectively and efficiently capture protein information, limiting overall prediction accuracy. In this work, we systematically evaluate the impact of pre-trained protein language models (PLMs) on the downstream task of predicting binding affinity between drugs and target proteins. We design multiple experiments across four different molecular representation backbones and assess the effect of incorporating PLM embeddings, comparing their performance to classical 1D convolution methods. We evaluate four families of PLMs which we integrate into PLM-GraphDTA, each built on distinct architectures and optimized for different tasks, including structure prediction, function prediction, and sequence unmasking. Additionally, we evaluate DeepGraphDTA, an architectural modification of the baseline convolution method designed to improve protein representation learning. The models are evaluated on two benchmark datasets, Davis and KIBA, using concordance index (CI) and mean squared error (MSE) as performance metrics. We further evaluate the generalization power of each model using cold-start train and test splits, and analyze the per-protein contribution to total CI. The results indicate simple architectural modifications to traditional convolution methods may be sufficient to bridge the gap to large pre-trained PLMs. 药物-靶点相互作用的准确识别对于新药发现与开发至关重要。用于药物-靶点亲和力（DTA）预测的深度学习方法在加速药物发现和降低开发成本方面显示出巨大潜力。尽管图神经网络已改善了DTA预测任务中的药物表示学习，但许多模型仍难以有效且高效地捕获蛋白质信息，从而限制了整体预测准确性。在本研究中，我们系统评估了预训练蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）对预测药物与靶点蛋白之间结合亲和力的下游任务的影响。我们设计了跨四种不同分子表示骨干网络的多个实验，并评估了整合PLM嵌入的效果，将其性能与经典一维卷积方法进行比较。我们评估了四个PLM家族，并将其整合到PLM-GraphDTA中，每个家族基于不同架构构建，并针对不同任务优化，包括结构预测、功能预测和序列掩码。此外，我们评估了DeepGraphDTA，这是基线卷积方法的一种架构修改，旨在改善蛋白质表示学习。模型在两个基准数据集Davis和KIBA上评估，使用一致性指数（CI）和均方误差（MSE）作为性能指标。我们进一步使用冷启动训练和测试分割评估每个模型的泛化能力，并分析每个蛋白质对总CI的贡献。结果表明，对传统卷积方法的简单架构修改可能足以弥合与大型预训练PLMs之间的差距。

documents.title: Transnasal Administration of Surfactant Aerosol to the Lungs of Infants Using Direct Interfaces - Lessons Learned from Computational Fluid Dynamics.
meta: Jubaer, Hasan; Farkas, Dale; Dalton, Caleb; Momin, Mohammad A M; Hindle, Michael; Longest, Worth
documents.summary: 该文使用计算流体动力学优化婴儿经鼻表面活性剂气溶胶递送系统，研究对象为表面活性剂和婴儿呼吸道，不涉及无序蛋白、蛋白互作或相分离，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: PURPOSE: Direct-to-infant (D2I) transnasal aerosol surfactant therapy (AST) offers a promising non-invasive alternative for treating neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (RDS). However, achieving high lung delivery efficiency with dry powder inhalers (DPIs) requires careful optimization of complex fluid-particle interactions. This study used computational fluid dynamics (CFD) to optimize an Infant Air‑Jet Dry Powder Aerosol Delivery System (iDP‑ADS) and derive transferable design principles. METHODS: A CFD model of the iDP‑ADS coupled to a 31‑week preterm nose‑throat geometry was validated against in vitro measurements. Sensitivity analyses evaluated modeling assumptions (steady‑state vs. transient, monodisperse vs. polydisperse) and critical design parameters influencing aerosol delivery, such as upstream air volume, interface geometry, temporal aerosol emission profiles, and actuation flow rates. RESULTS: The CFD model demonstrated strong in vitro agreement (2.8% mean absolute difference). Regarding modeling: standard simplifications, particularly steady-state approximations, overpredicted lung transmission (~24%), establishing the necessity of high-fidelity transient simulations with polydisperse aerosols. Regarding aerosol delivery: integrating an upstream air volume created "hydrodynamic shielding," reducing relative interface losses by up to 50%. A 10 mm diffusive path length and 20 degrees  (inward and downward) prong alignment balanced jet dissipation while minimizing nasal deposition. Front-loading of aerosol emission prevented entrapment of 10-14% of the dose in anatomical dead space. An optimal system-specific actuation flow rate of 3 L/min achieved ~53.5% aerosol lung transmission, balancing aerosolization efficiency against turbulence-driven transport losses. CONCLUSIONS: High-efficiency transnasal AST requires balancing often competing aerosol generation physics, transport behavior, and clinical constraints. This study highlights CFD as a vital design tool, providing key lessons to inform future modeling and practical interface development. 目的：直接对婴儿（D2I）经鼻气溶胶表面活性剂治疗（AST）为新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征（RDS）提供了一种有前景的无创替代方案。然而，使用干粉吸入器（DPIs）实现高肺部递送效率需要仔细优化复杂的流体-颗粒相互作用。本研究采用计算流体动力学（CFD）优化婴儿空气喷射干粉气溶胶递送系统（iDP‑ADS），并推导出可迁移的设计原则。方法：建立了与31周早产儿鼻咽几何结构耦合的iDP‑ADS的CFD模型，并通过体外测量进行了验证。敏感性分析评估了建模假设（稳态与瞬态、单分散与多分散）以及影响气溶胶递送的关键设计参数，如上游空气体积、接口几何结构、气溶胶发射时间分布和驱动流速。结果：CFD模型与体外结果高度一致（平均绝对差异2.8%）。关于建模：标准简化方法，特别是稳态近似，高估了肺部传输率（约24%），从而确立了采用多分散气溶胶进行高保真瞬态模拟的必要性。关于气溶胶递送：整合上游空气体积产生了“流体动力学屏蔽”，将相对接口损失降低了高达50%。10 mm扩散路径长度和20度（向内和向下）的叉头对齐在平衡射流耗散的同时最小化了鼻腔沉积。气溶胶发射的前置加载防止了10-14%的剂量滞留在解剖死腔中。系统特定的最佳驱动流速为3 L/min，实现了约53.5%的气溶胶肺部传输率，在气溶胶化效率与湍流驱动的传输损失之间取得了平衡。结论：高效经鼻AST需要平衡通常相互竞争的气溶胶生成物理机制、传输行为及临床约束。本研究强调了CFD作为关键设计工具的作用，为未来建模和实际接口开发提供了重要经验。

documents.title: Beyond Equilibrium Ensembles: Time Rescaling in Coarse-Grained Simulations across Single-Molecule and Condensate Regimes
meta: Gopi S; Qin H; Best RB; Schuler B
documents.summary: 该文使用残基级粗粒化模拟研究无序蛋白prothymosin α与阳离子伴侣形成的凝聚体，聚焦平衡与非平衡动力学的时间尺度重标，揭示了PPI对摩擦效应的影响，直接关联无序蛋白介导的相分离PPI机制建模。
documents.abstract:
ABSTRACT

Residue-level coarse-grained simulations provide a powerful route for modeling biomolecular condensates over length and time scales that are difficult to access with atomistic molecular dynamics. Coarse-grained models have been shown to reproduce many aspects of equilibrium phase behavior. However, it remains unclear to what extent such models can reproduce the relative timescales of molecular dynamics. Here, we examine this question for complex coacervates with markedly different dynamics, formed by the highly acidic intrinsically disordered protein prothymosin α with four cationic partners: linker histone H1, protamine, polylysine, and polyarginine. Coexistence simulations using a residue-level coarse-grained model reproduce key equilibrium observables from experiments, including dense-phase concentrations, ionic-strength-dependent phase behavior, and chain dimensions in the dense and dilute phases. Dynamics are accelerated in these simulations, but a composition-specific time-rescaling factor captures the ionic-strength dependence of chain reconfiguration times within a given complex coacervate. In contrast, time rescaling is not transferable between dense and dilute phases or across condensate compositions and can depend on the chosen observable. These results show that agreement with measured equilibrium observables does not imply a universally transferable timescale for conformational dynamics in residue-level coarse-grained simulations. However, we find that the required time rescaling strongly correlates with the interaction energy of the protein chains, suggesting that the missing frictional effects arise from protein-protein interactions rather than solely from protein-solvent interactions, reminiscent of internal friction. Our findings highlight the need to combine thermodynamic validation with kinetic calibration when interpreting chain relaxation, molecular diffusion, and material properties from residue-level coarse-grained simulations of biomolecular condensates.

摘要

残基层级粗粒化模拟为在原子分子动力学 (atomistic molecular dynamics) 难以触及的长度和时间尺度上模拟生物分子凝聚体提供了强大途径。粗粒化模型已被证明能够再现平衡相行为的许多方面。然而，这类模型能在多大程度上再现分子动力学的相对时间尺度仍不清楚。在此，我们针对由高度酸性的固有无序蛋白 prothymosin α 与四种阳离子伴侣——连接组蛋白 H1 (linker histone H1)、鱼精蛋白 (protamine)、聚赖氨酸 (polylysine) 和聚精氨酸 (polyarginine)——形成的、具有显著不同动力学的复合凝聚体，探讨了这一问题。使用残基层级粗粒化模型进行的共存模拟再现了实验中的关键平衡观测量，包括密相浓度、离子强度依赖性相行为以及密相和稀相中的链尺寸。这些模拟中的动力学被加速，但一个特定于组成的时标重缩放因子能够捕捉给定复合凝聚体内链重构时间的离子强度依赖性。相比之下，时标重缩放无法在密相和稀相之间或跨凝聚体组成转移，并且可能依赖于所选的观测量。这些结果表明，与测量的平衡观测量一致并不意味着残基层级粗粒化模拟中构象动力学具有普遍可转移的时标。然而，我们发现所需的时标重缩放与蛋白质链的相互作用能强相关，这表明缺失的摩擦效应源于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，而非仅源于蛋白质-溶剂相互作用，这让人联想到内摩擦 (internal friction)。我们的发现强调了在从生物分子凝聚体的残基层级粗粒化模拟中解释链弛豫、分子扩散和材料性质时，需要将热力学验证与动力学校准相结合。

documents.title: Prediction of Intrinsically Disordered Regions That Bind RNA with DisoRDPbind.
documents.summary: 该文介绍预测RNA结合无序区域(DisoRDPbind)的工具，聚焦无序蛋白与RNA的互作预测，但方法为传统机器学习而非AI/物理模拟，且未深入互作机制建模，对本课题有参考价值但非核心方向。
documents.abstract: A common cellular function of intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) is molecular binding, which covers interactions with various partner molecules, including proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, lipids, and small molecules. While there are many computational predictors of binding IDRs, relatively few target IDRs that bind RNAs. We focus on one of the first tools designed to predict RNA-binding IDRs: DisoRDPbind. DisoRDPbind is available as an easy-to-use web server at http://biomine.cs.vcu.edu/servers/DisoRDPbind/ . We describe the predictive model employed by DisoRDPbind and discuss its predictive performance and runtime, which were recently measured in the second CAID (Critical Assessment of protein Intrinsic Disorder) experiment. We highlight the small computational footprint of DisoRDPbind, which allows for large/proteome-scale predictions. We detail how to use the web server interface of DisoRDPbind and provide an example to illustrate how to read and interpret its prediction results. While DisoRDPbind does not identify RNA chaperones directly, we present a case study of an RNA chaperone, HCV core protein, to illustrate the method's utility in studying RNA chaperones. 内在无序区域（intrinsically disordered regions, IDRs）的一个常见细胞功能是分子结合，这涵盖与多种伙伴分子的相互作用，包括蛋白质、肽、核酸、脂质和小分子。虽然存在许多用于预测结合性IDRs的计算工具，但针对结合RNA的IDRs的工具相对较少。我们聚焦于最早设计用于预测RNA结合IDRs的工具之一：DisoRDPbind。DisoRDPbind可通过易于使用的网络服务器在 http://biomine.cs.vcu.edu/servers/DisoRDPbind/ 获取。我们描述了DisoRDPbind采用的预测模型，并讨论了其预测性能和运行时间，这些指标最近在第二次CAID（Critical Assessment of protein Intrinsic Disorder）实验中进行了测量。我们强调了DisoRDPbind的小计算开销，这使得其适用于大规模/蛋白质组规模的预测。我们详细说明了如何使用DisoRDPbind的网络服务器界面，并提供了一个示例来阐释如何读取和解释其预测结果。虽然DisoRDPbind不直接识别RNA伴侣（RNA chaperones），但我们通过一个RNA伴侣——HCV核心蛋白的案例研究，展示了该方法在研究RNA伴侣中的实用性。

documents.title: The Epichaperome Matrix Theory: A systems-level model of active molecular organization.
documents.summary: 该文提出表观伴侣体基质理论，用静电学、输运理论等构建多尺度系统模型，虽涉及蛋白互作与凝聚体热力学，但对象非IDP且无AI/物理模拟方法，机制建模思路可迁移。
documents.abstract: BACKGROUND: Epichaperomes are stable, stress-induced supramolecular assemblies formed through extensive integration of molecular chaperones, co-chaperones, signaling proteins, and client proteins. Although increasing evidence indicates that epichaperomes act as organizational hubs that coordinate proteostasis and signaling networks in cancer, neurodegenerative disorders, and chronic inflammatory diseases, their potential physical roles in cellular organization remain largely unexplored. RESULTS: Here, the Epichaperome Matrix Theory, a systems-level theoretical framework that conceptualizes the epichaperome as a dynamic, nonequilibrium biomolecular matrix possessing emergent transport-regulatory properties, is proposed. In this model, epichaperome assemblies generate heterogeneous electrostatic landscapes through the collective distribution of charged amino acid residues, phosphorylation-dependent charge accumulation, ATP-driven conformational dynamics, and high-order network connectivity. By integrating principles from Poisson-Boltzmann electrostatics, Nernst-Planck transport theory, active matter physics, percolation theory, graph theory, biomolecular condensate thermodynamics, and porous hydrogel transport models, a mathematical description in which epichaperomes function as adaptive organizational scaffolds capable of influencing molecular flux, signaling efficiency, and spatial coordination within cells is developed. This framework is further extended through the Transcellular Epichaperome Continuum Hypothesis, proposing that intracellular epichaperomes may be functionally coupled to plasma membrane-associated and extracellular epichaperome assemblies, forming a multiscale organizational network spanning individual cells, tissues, and organ systems. In this extended model, membrane-bound epichaperomes act as coupling interfaces between intracellular and extracellular compartments, while secreted chaperones, extracellular vesicles, and extracellular protein assemblies contribute to intercellular connectivity. Mathematical analysis predicts the emergence of percolating transport networks, electrostatic coupling domains, synchronized conformational dynamics, and stress-responsive communication pathways when epichaperome connectivity exceeds critical thresholds. CONCLUSIONS: The proposed framework suggests that epichaperomes may represent more than stress-associated protein interaction networks and could function as dynamic organizational matrices integrating molecular organization, signaling, and adaptive responses across multiple biological scales. Although the theory remains speculative and currently lacks direct experimental validation, it generates testable predictions regarding membrane-associated epichaperomes, extracellular epichaperome assemblies, electrostatic organization, and intercellular transport behaviors. By providing a unified theoretical foundation linking stress biology, chaperone networks, systems biology, and biophysics, this work expands the conceptual landscape of epichaperome research and identifies new directions for investigating the role of higher-order chaperome organization in health and disease. 背景：Epichaperomes 是在应激条件下通过分子伴侣 (molecular chaperones)、共伴侣蛋白 (co-chaperones)、信号蛋白 (signaling proteins) 和客户蛋白 (client proteins) 的广泛整合形成的稳定超分子组装体。尽管越来越多的证据表明，epichaperomes 在癌症、神经退行性疾病和慢性炎症性疾病中充当协调蛋白质稳态 (proteostasis) 和信号网络的组织枢纽，但其在细胞组织中的潜在物理作用仍 largely unexplored。结果：本文提出了 Epichaperome Matrix Theory，这是一个系统层面的理论框架，将 epichaperome 概念化为一种具有 emergent transport-regulatory properties 的动态非平衡生物分子基质 (biomolecular matrix)。在该模型中，epichaperome 组装体通过带电氨基酸残基的集体分布、磷酸化依赖性电荷积累、ATP 驱动的构象动力学 (conformational dynamics) 以及高阶网络连接性，产生异质静电景观。通过整合 Poisson-Boltzmann 静电学、Nernst-Planck 输运理论、活性物质物理学 (active matter physics)、渗流理论 (percolation theory)、图论 (graph theory)、生物分子凝聚体热力学 (biomolecular condensate thermodynamics) 和多孔水凝胶输运模型 (porous hydrogel transport models) 的原理，我们发展了一个数学描述，其中 epichaperomes 作为适应性组织支架，能够影响细胞内的分子通量、信号效率和空间协调。该框架进一步通过 Transcellular Epichaperome Continuum Hypothesis 扩展，提出细胞内 epichaperomes 可能与质膜相关和细胞外 epichaperome 组装体功能耦合，形成一个跨越单个细胞、组织和器官系统的多尺度组织网络。在这个扩展模型中，膜结合 epichaperomes 作为细胞内和细胞外区室之间的耦合界面，而分泌的伴侣蛋白、细胞外囊泡 (extracellular vesicles) 和细胞外蛋白组装体则促进细胞间连接。数学分析预测，当 epichaperome 连接性超过临界阈值时，会出现渗流输运网络、静电耦合域、同步构象动力学和应激响应通信通路。结论：所提出的框架表明，epichaperomes 可能不仅仅是应激相关的蛋白质相互作用网络，而是作为动态组织基质，在多个生物学尺度上整合分子组织、信号传导和适应性反应。尽管该理论仍属推测性，且目前缺乏直接实验验证，但它产生了关于膜相关 epichaperomes、细胞外 epichaperome 组装体、静电组织和细胞间输运行为的可检验预测。通过提供一个连接应激生物学、伴侣网络、系统生物学和生物物理学的统一理论基础，这项工作扩展了 epichaperome 研究的概念图景，并确定了研究高阶 chaperome 组织在健康和疾病中作用的新方向。

documents.title: Multicomplex Integrative Structural Modeling of a Human Histone Deacetylase Interactome.
meta: Nde, Jules; Majila, Kartik; Zimmermann, Rosalyn C; Kempf, Cassandra; Zhang, Ying; Cesare, Joseph; Thornton, Janet L; Workman, Jerry L; Florens, Laurence; Viswanath, Shruthi; Washburn, Michael P
documents.summary: 该文结合XL-MS与AlphaFold的整合建模，构建含HDAC1 CTD无序区域的NuRD等复合物结构，揭示IDR折叠为α螺旋并参与PPI组装，直接契合无序蛋白互作机制建模主题。
documents.abstract: Histone Deacetylase (HDAC) 1 and 2 are key enzymatic components in multiple large chromatin remodeling complexes including NuRD, SIN3, and CoREST. In addition, both HDAC 1 and 2 contain a large intrinsically disordered region (IDR) within their C-terminal domain (CTD). How HDAC1/2 assemble into these complexes and the structure of the CTD IDR remains poorly understood. Here, we used HDAC1/2 to isolate their protein interaction networks from cells and used crosslinking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) coupled with the Integrative Modeling Platform to build structural models of the NuRD, SIN3A, and CoREST complexes. Next, we implemented an AlphaFold-enabled XL-MS constrained modeling approach to investigate how HDAC1 could assemble into these complexes. We show that the CTD IDR of HDAC1 folds into alpha helices in these complexes. Finally, we built a complete integrative structural model of a NuRD subcomplex including the abundant HDAC1:MBD3:MTA1:GATAD2B:RBBP4 subunits, which included 6 IDRs. The approaches used herein are broadly applicable for the study of protein complexes and protein interaction networks that can provide important insights into IDRs. 组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）1和2是多个大型染色质重塑复合物（包括NuRD、SIN3和CoREST）中的关键酶组分。此外，HDAC1和2在其C端结构域（CTD）内均含有一个大的固有无序区域（IDR）。HDAC1/2如何组装成这些复合物以及CTD IDR的结构仍知之甚少。在此，我们利用HDAC1/2从细胞中分离其蛋白质相互作用网络，并结合交联质谱（XL-MS）与整合建模平台构建了NuRD、SIN3A和CoREST复合物的结构模型。接下来，我们采用了一种AlphaFold增强的XL-MS约束建模方法，以研究HDAC1如何组装到这些复合物中。我们表明，HDAC1的CTD IDR在这些复合物中折叠成α螺旋。最后，我们构建了一个NuRD亚复合物的完整整合结构模型，包括丰富的HDAC1:MBD3:MTA1:GATAD2B:RBBP4亚基，其中包含6个IDR。本文所采用的方法广泛适用于蛋白质复合物和蛋白质相互作用网络的研究，可为IDR提供重要见解。

documents.title: A germline KDM3C polymorphism impairs DNA repair and sensitizes to chemoradiotherapy
meta: Hasan A; Demidova EV; Priyadarshini P; Czyzewicz P; Gathuka L; Murayama T; Zhou Y; Kiss ZA; Shastry RK; Andrake M; Hearne G; Devarajan K; Wu C; Shah A; Schultz BM; Connolly DC; Rosen GL; Canadas I; Liu JC; Burtness BA; Smith JJ; Dunbrack RL; Golemis EA; Whetstine JR; Meyer JE; Arora S
documents.summary: 该研究通过AlphaFold预测KDM3C无序区域SNP影响其与RNF8的互作，并实验验证DNA修复与化疗敏感性，虽涉及IDR和PPI及AI建模，但核心是临床表型与DNA修复机制，非相分离/凝聚体背景，互作机制建模深度有限。
documents.abstract: Chemoradiotherapy (CRT) is the standard-of-care therapy for many solid malignancies, yet predictive biomarkers of treatment response remain limited. We identified a germline single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) in an intrinsically disordered region of the lysine demethylase KDM3C/JMJD1C (p.S464T) that is associated with CRT outcomes in locally advanced rectal cancers (LARC) and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (LA-HNSCC). In silico modeling with AlphaFold predicted S464T substitution influenced interaction between phosphorylated KDM3C and RNF8 FHA domain. In cellular models, conversion of S464 to T464 increased sensitivity to DNA-damaging agents. S464T substitution impaired damage-induced MDC1-RAP80 signaling and downstream RAP80-BRCA1 colocalization. SNP carrying cells impaired DNA repair causing genotoxic stress that is associated with increased cGAS-cGAMP innate immune signaling and increased apoptosis. Population analyses with the SNP highlighted an increase incidence of UV-induced skin and other cancers, linking inherited variation in the chromatin regulatory gene KDM3C to genome instability, cancer risk, and therapeutic vulnerability. 化放疗（CRT）是多种实体恶性肿瘤的标准治疗方案，然而治疗反应的预测性生物标志物仍然有限。我们在赖氨酸去甲基化酶KDM3C/JMJD1C的一个内在无序区域中鉴定出一个种系单核苷酸多态性（SNP）（p.S464T），该多态性与局部晚期直肠癌（LARC）和头颈部鳞状细胞癌（LA-HNSCC）的CRT结局相关。利用AlphaFold进行的计算机模拟预测表明，S464T替换影响了磷酸化KDM3C与RNF8 FHA结构域之间的相互作用。在细胞模型中，S464转换为T464增加了对DNA损伤剂的敏感性。S464T替换损害了损伤诱导的MDC1-RAP80信号传导及下游RAP80-BRCA1共定位。携带SNP的细胞DNA修复受损，导致基因毒性应激，这与cGAS-cGAMP先天免疫信号增强和细胞凋亡增加相关。对SNP的人群分析突显了紫外线诱导的皮肤癌及其他癌症发病率的增加，将染色质调控基因KDM3C的遗传变异与基因组不稳定性、癌症风险和治疗脆弱性联系起来。

documents.title: A machine learning framework for predicting and modulating condition-dependent protein phase separation.
meta: Bae, Jangwon; Kang, Minjun; Lee, Donghyuk; Yoon, Kuk-Jin; Jung, Yongwon
documents.summary: 该文提出LLPSense，一个整合蛋白质语言模型嵌入与环境参数的机器学习框架，用于预测和调控条件依赖的蛋白质相分离，直接以无序蛋白/相分离为对象，研究PPI相关的相分离机制，并采用AI方法，高度契合本课题。
documents.abstract: Protein phase separation is a fundamental process in organizing membraneless organelles and is implicated in pathological conditions. Importantly, this process is dynamic and depends on conditions such as concentration, temperature, and solvent composition. However, current machine learning models infer phase separation propensity solely from amino acid sequences, failing to capture these context-dependent behaviors. Here we show that LLPSense, a machine learning framework that integrates protein language model embeddings with environmental parameters, achieves accurate, condition-aware predictions of phase separation. Multiple experimental validations confirm LLPSense's predictive power and utility. The model reveals complex, temperature-dependent reentrant behavior in SGTA, previously unrecognized as phase-separating. Moreover, LLPSense accurately predicts mutations in Parkinson's disease-associated alpha-synuclein that either enhance or suppress phase separation. Beyond predictive accuracy, model-guided mutagenesis enables the modulation of phase behavior. Collectively, LLPSense establishes a robust computational framework for interrogating phase landscapes, facilitating mechanistic disease studies and programmable condensate design. 蛋白质相分离（phase separation）是组织无膜细胞器的基本过程，并与病理状态相关。重要的是，这一过程是动态的，并依赖于浓度、温度和溶剂组成等条件。然而，当前的机器学习模型仅从氨基酸序列推断相分离倾向，未能捕捉这些依赖于情境的行为。在此，我们展示LLPSense，一种将蛋白质语言模型嵌入与环境参数相结合的机器学习框架，实现了准确且情境感知的相分离预测。多项实验验证确认了LLPSense的预测能力和实用性。该模型揭示了SGTA中复杂的、温度依赖的重入行为，此前未被识别为相分离蛋白。此外，LLPSense准确预测了与帕金森病相关的α-突触核蛋白中增强或抑制相分离的突变。除了预测准确性外，模型引导的诱变能够调节相行为。总体而言，LLPSense建立了一个稳健的计算框架，用于探究相景观，促进机制性疾病研究和可编程凝聚体设计。
